slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: greeting
slots.about: the big line on top, e.g. a hello with the person's name

slots.name: today_label
slots.about: the section title over the hero card

slots.name: sessions
slots.about: the plan: id, weekday (1 Sunday to 7 Saturday), kind (a kind id), name, minutes, about (a short line), coach (a name)

slots.name: kinds
slots.about: the tray of other kinds: id, name, icon (a Tabler icon name)

slots.name: done
slots.about: the days a session was done: date

slots.name: swapped_word
slots.about: the hero's note when a kind from the tray replaced today's plan

slots.name: minutes_word
slots.about: after the minutes on the hero

slots.name: start_word
slots.about: the hero button before today is done

slots.name: done_word
slots.about: the hero button once today is done

slots.name: undo_word
slots.about: spoken on the hero button once today is done

slots.name: rest_text
slots.about: what the hero says on a day with nothing planned

slots.name: week_title
slots.about: the title of the week card

slots.name: week_word
slots.about: after the count on the week card

empty.shows: rest: nothing planned today (or nothing of the picked kind), the hero gives way to rest_text; an empty tray hides

fallback.shows: the hero shows the first session of the picked kind with swapped_word; the same kind again goes back to today's plan

attention.shows: the hero button turns to done with a check; the week count and bar move

labels.log: start_word or undo_word and the session name

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, shrink and swap

notes: The hero follows the date: the plan for today's weekday, or a picked kind. Done is per day, so a swapped session counts for today too. The week count starts on the phone's first_weekday.
